messages:
Sara: hey team — quick request for next week's Serving Wins webinar (May 15). Need a small asset bundle: hero slide (1920x1080, static), benchmark diagram (latency vs cost comparison with callouts), slide master (editable), 3 social tiles (1:1, 9:16 story, 16:9), email header, + a 1-page SDR one-pager. Brand compliance checklist required. Figma files here: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins?node-id=0%3A1. Deadline: EOD Wed for first pass. @Anya @Matt please. Also need HubSpot form mapping + UTM scheme for inbound routing.
Matt: got it. Can you confirm whether the benchmark diag should be stylized (illustrative) or data-first? also need figma perms and the raw numbers.
Sara: data-first but simplified for clarity — one primary chart + 2 callouts (latency, cost). Raw numbers are in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE. Copy we can use below. FigJam perms: team can edit.
Nina: copy options (short):
- Variant A: "Serving wins: 3x lower per-token cost, predictable latency."
- Variant B: "Ship smarter LLM features — faster responses, lower cost."
- Variant C: "Optimize inference: cut cost, keep quality."
Pick one for hero, others for social CTAs.
Anya: thanks — a couple Qs:
1) can I get the CSV for the chart (time/model,cost,latency) so I can plot exact dots? the sheet link is blocked for me currently.
2) chart colors: use brand solids or gradient? gradients reduce legibility for small tiles.
3) co-marketing logo lockup — stacked or horizontal for hero?
Lucas: brand note: use primary palette (Redwood Blue / Ink) for bars/lines; avoid gradients for data viz — solid fills only. Logo: stacked for hero, horizontal for footer/one-pager. Minimum clearspace = 24px. Use our accessible color pairings (I'll paste swatches into the figma file).
Ben: inbound routing + UTMs — use this template:

utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=serving_wins_may15

HubSpot form mapping (sample):
```
lead_source => "Webinar: Serving Wins"
utm_campaign => "serving_wins_may15"
lead_tags => "webinar_servingwins_may15"
```
Tag leads with `webinar_servingwins_may15` and set lifecycle trigger to MQL when form_completed = true. I can share the form embed code if needed.
Anya: will queue hero + benchmark diag first. ETA for initial comps Tue 5pm. need that CSV and final headline selection.
Sara: selecting Variant B for hero. CSV link updated and view perms opened for @Anya. Also adding a column in the sheet called "approved_for_publish" — please mark when legal is done.
Jill: legal here — we'll run a claims review. send the source API runs that produced the numbers, and we'll review by Tue noon. small edits on language may be required.
designbot: Reminder: file created in Marketing > Campaigns/ServingWins, Figma prototype created and shared with participants.
Matt: i'll spin up the slide master with token-level cost callout components and include alt-text notes for accessibility. Will also export social tiles at required sizes and check contrast.
Anya: one more ask — for the benchmark diagram can we include a small explanatory caption (1-2 lines) rather than dense axis labels? helps social readability.
Sara: yes, include a 1-line caption under the diagram: "Comparison of per-token cost vs. median latency across models/configs — lower is better." keep it simple.
Matt: noted. i'll add spacing for caption and make sure exports include PNG + SVG for engineering.
Jill: once comps are in, legal will check the caption and callouts. no absolute % claims without source note.
Sara: perfect. i'll ping when numbers are verified. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
notes: Design ops request for webinar + asset production; contains Figma + sheet links, UTMs, and HubSpot mapping snippet.
